extraction.Name: Alexander Whipple
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I bought cattle . mortgage it as security, and couldn't pay out on the cattle and I offered to turn the deed over if they would take care of my mortgage papers. They would not do that they wanted to foreclose and get a deficiency judgment against me for the balance of the amount, so I went through bankruptcy.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered by mail at Parmelee; signed a receipt for it. States 'I believe that I would have been better off had I never received the patent.' Married with six living children. Subscribed and sworn before E. E.
